scope: Current database migration ledger and audit counts only; not the full AUD-03 operational recorder envelope.
limits: HTTP status >=400 count is historical operation-log rows, not a current incident rate
Zero outbox rows do not prove dispatch, recovery, duplicate prevention or replay
Applied migration ledger and empty pending plan do not establish a historical failed-migration count
No recovery drill, archive restore, authority creation or writer smoke executed

samples.label: aud03_current_readonly
samples.command: docker exec -i -e PGOPTIONS='-c default_transaction_read_only=on -c statement_timeout=60000' 0c695cfec9dd python -
samples.input:
import os,json,hashlib
from datetime import datetime,UTC
from pathlib import Path
os.environ.setdefault("DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE","core.settings")
import django
django.setup()
from django.conf import settings
from django.db import connection,transaction
from django.db.models import Count,Min,Q
from django.db.migrations.executor import MigrationExecutor
from apps.audit.infrastructure.system_audit_outbox_models import SystemAuditOutboxModel
from apps.audit.infrastructure.models import OperationLogModel
with transaction.atomic():
 with connection.cursor() as c:
  c.execute("SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ, READ ONLY")
  c.execute("SELECT transaction_timestamp(),current_setting('transaction_read_only')")
  tx=c.fetchone()
 executor=MigrationExecutor(connection)
 applied=sorted(executor.loader.applied_migrations)
 pending=[{'app':m.app_label,'name':m.name,'backwards':back} for m,back in executor.migration_plan(executor.loader.graph.leaf_nodes())]
 qs=SystemAuditOutboxModel.objects.all()
 outbox={'total':qs.count(),'status_counts':list(qs.values('status').annotate(count=Count('outbox_id'))),'due_pending_count':qs.filter(status='pending',available_at__lte=tx[0]).count(),'oldest_backlog_at':qs.filter(status__in=['pending','failed']).aggregate(at=Min('created_at'))['at'],'oldest_claimed_at':qs.filter(status='claimed').aggregate(at=Min('claimed_at'))['at']}
 logs=OperationLogModel.objects.aggregate(count=Count('id'),http_failure_count=Count('id',filter=Q(response_status__gte=400)))
 print(json.dumps({'manifest':json.loads(Path(settings.AGOM_RELEASE_MANIFEST_PATH).read_text()),'transaction':tx,'applied_count':len(applied),'pending':pending,'applied_migrations_sha256':hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(applied,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest(),'outbox':outbox,'operation_logs':logs,'recovery_drill':'not_executed','archive_restore':'not_executed'},default=str,sort_keys=True))
